About

Learning defensive security from the ground up

I'm a final-year Artificial Intelligence student in the Cyber Security Department at Delta University for Science and Technology, in Egypt. My career direction is SOC and defensive security — I'm drawn to how security teams monitor, detect, investigate, and respond to threats, rather than only how attacks are carried out.

Through coursework, labs, and industry training, I've built practical exposure to networking, Linux and Windows administration, cybersecurity fundamentals, SIEM concepts, security monitoring, incident response, and digital forensics. I'm currently deepening this through the DEPI Cyber Security Incident Responder program while applying what I learn in hands-on labs and academic projects.

Featured Projects

Academic & lab-built projects

Applied projects combining AI and cybersecurity, built for coursework and self-directed learning.

AI-Driven Cyber Defense System for Threat Detection

PythonMachine LearningThreat Detection
GitHub

Problem

Manually spotting suspicious network activity is slow and easy to miss in growing traffic volumes.

Solution

An academic system that applies machine learning models to analyze traffic patterns and flag simulated attack behaviour for review.

Key Features

  • ML-based detection of simulated attack types
  • Automated flagging to support response decisions
  • Focus on intelligent, data-driven analysis

Results

Successfully classified simulated attack scenarios in a controlled academic environment.

Integrated Network Monitoring & URL Phishing Detection System

PythonRandom ForestIsolation ForestWeb DashboardChatbot
GitHub

Problem

Phishing URLs and abnormal network activity often go unnoticed without integrated, accessible monitoring.

Solution

A combined system for network monitoring and URL phishing detection, using ML models with a web-based dashboard and an intelligent chatbot for interaction.

Key Features

  • Random Forest & Isolation Forest models
  • Web-based monitoring dashboard
  • Intelligent chatbot interface
  • Security-oriented data analysis

Results

Co-authored as a research paper, accepted at IEEE ITC-Egypt 2026.
